config.script:
import os
	
	# Your starting path
	original_path = self.getSibling("rootFolder").props.text
	
	# Get the parent directory (this simply strips the last component off the string)
	parent_dir = os.path.dirname(original_path)
	
	self.getSibling("rootFolder").props.text=parent_dir
	self.view.getChild("root").get_tree_data(parent_dir)

customMethods.name: get_tree_data
